findings.severity: high for public helper; outside main theorem
findings.title: Accepted N=M=2 covariance input has wrong closed-form matrix
findings.basis: Exact algebraic enumeration of two allowed states; not code execution
findings.impact: Actual covariance is 0.5*ones(2,2); source formula returns 0.5*I. Restrict domain or include displacement aliases.

findings.title: Streaming entry point does not enforce variance regime and zero shortcut bypasses validation
findings.impact: K>=2M is not checked; empty, nonvector, invalid-M/dtype zero cases behave differently from nonzero cases.

findings.title: Public lower-level decoders omit dimension/state checks
findings.impact: Nondividing block size accepted; invalid seeds can leave np.empty output elements unwritten in unvalidated sequential helpers.

findings.title: N=1 accepted by generic dyadic checks but has no odd-state/two-seed path
findings.impact: draw_state requests an empty RNG range; zero fast path elsewhere hides mismatch.

findings.title: Majority state omits common grid radius and checked counter domain
findings.impact: Changing tau or finalizing untouched/malformed state is unchecked; int32 counters do not support arbitrary rows.

findings.title: Numerical and bound-helper input validation is inconsistent
findings.impact: Nonfinite parameters, overflowed grid width, nonrepresentable IDs and invalid probability-helper domains are not uniformly rejected.

findings.title: Ideal error radius is not certified for supplied mixed-precision source
findings.basis: Source plus reconciliation with prior V8 precision report
findings.impact: Double-precision summary/FFT/roots precede lower-precision casts; no certified numerical allowance or exact represented-grid classification.

findings.title: O(N) decoder and memory statements need charged FFT, primitive and word-width assumptions
findings.impact: General row cost O(N+KlogK); state is O(N) words with logR-bit counters; input and N-output, root setup and floor costs remain.

findings.title: Supplied tests do not measure confidence, peak memory or runtime scaling
findings.impact: Formula checks and symbolic proxies cannot establish implementation correctness/performance; saved pass log remains historical evidence.
